page.noSeasons: Guild War data isn't available yet.

settings.title: Guild War settings
settings.description: The season and battlefield level of your current war.
settings.capsKept: Attacks already logged keep the rarity cap they were logged at.
settings.stale: Your war changed on another device. It shows as it is now.
settings.failed: Couldn't save the settings. Try again.

history.emptyDescription: A war moves here when you start a new one from Offense.

target.title: Zone and slot
target.content: Pick the zone and slot you are attacking. Every unit on the page shows at that slot's rarity cap, and the pick is remembered on this device.

settings.title: Season and level
settings.content: Your war's season and battlefield level. Change them with Settings at the top right.

summary.title: Your war
summary.content: Tokens used of this war's attempts, units you still have per rarity, and attacks won and lost.

teams.title: Offense teams
teams.content: Your War Offense teams: ready ones first, then the ones blocked by a unit that already attacked.

units.title: Available units
units.content: Your units that have not attacked in this war. Tap units or a team's Select, then Log attack.

log.title: Attack log
log.content: Every attack of this war, newest first. Undo removes a mistap and frees its units.

totals.title: Totals
totals.content: Win rates by zone tier and slot rarity, and your most used lineups, across the wars loaded below.

wars.title: Past wars
wars.content: Your ended wars, newest first. Open one to see its attacks.
